name: @ref
description: Your reference images, searched by pose instead of by folder. Every indexed image carries the orientation of its subject (yaw/pitch/roll, like a gimbal holding a mannequin); finding a reference is pointing the gimbal at the view you are drawing — '3/4 left, slightly from above' — not remembering which folder it landed in. Poses come from an optional local estimator (mediapipe, if installed) or from you, via the console's drag-gimbal; untagged images queue up until oriented. Local-first end to end: images never move from where they live on disk, the whole index is one SQLite file in ./data, and no request leaves the machine.

/query.docs: The gimbal query: ?yaw=&pitch=&roll=&tolerance=&tags= — refs within tolerance degrees of that view, nearest first

/describe.docs: What a gimbal position is called: ?yaw=&pitch=&roll= — e.g. '3/4 left, from above'

/scan.docs: Index every image under a folder in place: ?path=&tags= — auto-poses if a local estimator is installed

/set.docs: Pin a pose on an indexed image: ?id=&yaw=&pitch=&roll=&tags=

/untagged.docs: Indexed images still waiting for a pose

/file.docs: The image bytes for one indexed ref: ?id= (only indexed paths are ever served)

/stats.docs: Index totals, tag counts, where the database lives

/health.docs: Liveness plus which auto-estimators this box has

/.docs: The console: a draggable gimbal head, a wall of matches, an untagged queue
